attributes.name: Karzoug the Claimer
attributes.powers:
Karzoug the Claimer may not be evaded, and is immune to the Mental trait.

Before attempting to play a spell with the Attack trait, succeed at an Arcane or Divine 15 check or you are dealt 1 Poison damage and you may not play spells with the Attack trait.

Before the encounter, each character at this location attempts a Constitution or Fortitude 15 check. Characters who succeed are dealt 2 Poison damage; characters who fail are dealt 1d4+1 Fire damage.

After the encounter, Karzoug deals 1 Fire damage to each character without either the Arcane or Divine skill.
